_about: Read by `bun run deploy` (tools/deploy.ts). host: SSH alias of the restricted deploy account on the production host (locally in ~/.ssh/config; in GitHub Actions written by the workflow); every command it sends is checked by deploy/synergon-deploy-gate.sh on the server. remoteRoot: folder on the server holding releases/ and the symlink current; publicUrl: where the web server serves remoteRoot/current (with the trailing slash); keepReleases: release folders kept on the server. See wiki/50-implementation/deployment.md.
